scenes.vo: Lesson eight point two. The DeFi risk framework.

scenes.sub: Keep a risk register that scores every position's risks and names the response.
scenes.vo: Keep a risk register that scores every position's risks and names the response.
scenes.cap: Keep a risk register that scores every position's risks and names the response.

scenes.sub: The eight risk surfaces: smart-contract · economic · oracle · liquidity · governance · bridge/chain · counterparty · user-operation. Score each for likelihood (1–5) × impact (1–5). Anything ≥ 15 needs a mitigation or an exit; anything ≥ 20 shouldn't be held.
scenes.vo: The eight risk surfaces: smart-contract , economic , oracle , liquidity , governance , bridge/chain , counterparty , user-operation. Score each for likelihood (1–5) times impact (1–5). Anything at least 15 needs a mitigation or an exit; anything at least 20 shouldn't be held.
scenes.cap: The eight risk surfaces: smart-contract · economic · oracle · liquidity · governance · bridge/chain · counterparty · user-operation. Score each for likelihood (1–5) × impact (1–5). Anything ≥ 15 needs a mitigation or an exit; anything ≥ 20 shouldn't be held.
